office.roads_sentence: Our office is in the southwest corner of Summerville's historic core, just off West Carolina Avenue near the Pine Forest Inn historical marker: about a mile southwest of Town Hall and Hutchinson Square, a third of a mile northwest of South Main Street (US-17A), half a mile from Berlin G. Myers Parkway, under a mile north of the Bacons Bridge Road and Old Trolley Road junction, and three miles southwest of I-26 exits 199A and 199B. Linwood Lane runs between West Carolina Avenue and Salisbury Drive.
